summary: Verified Zelle derivation fix in _build_profile_public_response (server.py ~8916). Profile-level zelle_info is now correctly fanned out to zelle_email vs zelle_phone (by '@' presence) on both public endpoints, with master-level fallback when empty and whitespace stripping. 5/5 new tests pass; payment-handle regression suite remains green.
tests_run: TestZelleDerivation::test_other_payment_handles_intact (paypal/venmo/cashapp + enable flags + public response shape unchanged) PASS
endpoints_exercised: GET /api/profile (read master musician for fallback expectation)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 9904 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; should eventually be modularized (profiles, events, songs, requests, billing).

_build_profile_public_response correctly handles zelle_info derivation. Edge-case worth noting (not a bug, but documenting): non-stripped 'whitespace-only' inputs to PUT are coerced to None by the PUT endpoint (val=='' branch), so they cannot reach the serializer as a non-empty whitespace string; safe.
Master-fallback path uses musician.get('zelle_email')/('zelle_phone') directly (no sigil/whitespace cleaning), which is consistent with prior behavior for those legacy master fields.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test cleans up by resetting the default profile's zelle_info to empty after the module run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zelle derivation in _build_profile_public_response is verified working on both /api/musicians/{master}/{profile} and /api/musicians/{master} default-profile endpoints. New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_zelle_public_derivation.py. The test_payment_handle_cleaning suite is still passing.
rca of the issue: Previously the serializer set zelle_email/zelle_phone=None whenever profile.zelle_info was set, so a profile-level Zelle never reached the audience tip UI. Fix derives zelle_email vs zelle_phone from zelle_info by '@' presence, with strip() to normalize whitespace; empty zelle_info falls back to musician-level fields.
